name: Middle Tennessee State University
academic_ranking: Middle Tennessee State University is a large public doctoral research university and the largest undergraduate university in Tennessee. It offers 300+ programs across colleges including Business (Jones College of Business), Media and Entertainment, Behavioral and Health Sciences, and Basic and Applied Sciences. Total enrollment is roughly 20,000 students.
financial_aid: Public university; in-state tuition and required fees approximately $10,266 and out-of-state approximately $31,574 for 2024-25 (source: NCES College Navigator). MTSU reports about 80% of students receive some form of financial aid. Athletic scholarships administered through the athletics department; academic and need-based aid available via mtsu.edu/financial-aid.
facilities_notes: Blue Raiders softball plays home games at the MTSU Softball Field on the Murfreesboro campus. Athletics facilities are branded under goblueraiders.com; specific softball facility upgrade details not confirmed on the staff/roster pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in Conference USA (C-USA). Middle Tennessee softball is one of the Blue Raiders' varsity sports; program history and championship details were not detailed on the pages fetched. Reputation as an established mid-major C-USA program.
notes: Data captured from live fetch of goblueraiders.com softball coaches and roster pages on 2026-07. Roster size (20) counted from unique player profile links on the softball roster page. Conference (Conference USA) confirmed on the athletics site. Tuition figures from NCES College Navigator (2024-25).
